messages:
incident-bot: Automated page fired — latency SLO alert (p99 >= 2.0s) for inference-service in us-west-2 (7m window). See metrics: https://metrics.redwood.dev/alerts/INC-1745

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC1745001 created. Severity: P1. Notified: eng-oncall rotation. Escalation policy: 10m -> senior-oncall.

jason (oncall): ack. I'm looking. linking runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/Latency+Runbook

mira (eng): oncall? I can dig into model-side latency (KV cache miss rates). Starting load queries and tail-sample logs.

lee (infra): checking node metrics — GPU mem pressure not high. Noticed high sidecar CPU on inference-frontend.

tara (sre): any key hotkeys? k/v cache evictions spike at same time? Mira, can you paste cache miss rate?

mira (eng): Cache miss rate jumped to 18% (baseline 2%). Likely due to a rollout with changed prompt prefixes. Correlating with increased batch sizes.

jason (oncall): timeline: spike started at ~1745008200. Plan: 1) scale inference frontend replicas 2) reduce max-batch-size to drop tail 3) enable fallback model route if still bad. Agree?

lee (infra): scaling now — running:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-frontend --replicas=12
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/inference-frontend MAX_BATCH_SIZE=16
``` 
Rolling update triggered.

ops-bot: Autoscaler note — increased target replicas to 12 for deployment/inference-frontend (reason: manual override by jason). Current pods: 11 -> 12.

mira (eng): reducing batching config in control plane now. Pushing config version v2026-03-15-01. Applied.

pagerduty-bot: INC1745001 acknowledged by jason (oncall).

jason (oncall): initial p99 down from 2.6s -> 1.9s after scale+batch change. Still watching for sustained improvement. Checking customer impact reports.

tara (sre): routing fallback enabled: traffic split 80/20 to fallback-small model to keep latency. Route config:
```
route inference-api -> 80% model-a-v2, 20% model-a-quant-small
```

mira (eng): fallback reduced error budget burn. p99 now 1.4s. Good. Will keep split for 20m then revert.

jason (oncall): good progress. Notifying support to update customers: @support-team please flag higher latency for some requests, partial routing to smaller model. ETA revert 20m.

support-bot: Created ticket SUP-9876 for customer notifications.

lee (infra): monitoring for KV-cache warmup. Eviction count falling. Looks stable.

jason (oncall): preparing handoff. If p99 remains <1.6s for next 10m we'll resolve page. Otherwise escalate to senior-oncall per PD policy.

mira (eng): note for follow-up: investigate why rollout touched prompt prefixes and increased cache churn. Add regression test for prefix-preservation.

jason (oncall): closing actions: leave runbook link and list of commands executed in thread. If resolved, will mark incident resolved.

ops-bot: Incident state changed: monitoring -> stable. p99 back within SLO for 12m.

jason (oncall): Resolving PagerDuty incident INC1745001. Postmortem required because SLO burn > 30m. Assigning to mira for draft.

mira (eng): taking postmortem. Thanks everyone. :heart:
